notes: HPC Desktop 3.0. In Submit, the last step now always shows the run parent folder, the folder inside which every job gets its own new folder; in Files you can right-click a folder (or the empty space inside one) and choose "Use as run parent folder". Job e-mails are now sent by Slurm itself when the job starts, when it ends and if it fails, so they arrive even where the compute nodes cannot send mail; where they can, the job also adds a longer report. The view button in Files now shows the view it switches to. Not code-signed yet.
